name: Solai Tide Dark

surface.raised.usage: Raised containers; use text.secondary or brighter

surface.hover.usage: Hover or pressed fill; use text.primary or text.emphasis

border.subtle.usage: Decorative dividers; do not rely on this alone to identify a control

border.strong.usage: Essential control outlines on canvas, panel or raised surfaces; recheck other pairings

text.primary.usage: Primary readable text on all four neutral surfaces

text.secondary.usage: Body-color role; normal-sized text on canvas, panel and raised surfaces

text.muted.usage: Muted readable text on canvas and panel; use a brighter grade on raised or hover surfaces

text.disabled.usage: Inactive or decorative text only; source comment-grade color is below the normal-text contrast target

accent.primary.usage: Primary identity: links on canvas/panel; filled primary controls with accent.ink labels

accent.hover.usage: Hover/active accent and links on raised surfaces

accent.highlight.usage: High emphasis, cursor and small highlight details; reserve sparingly

accent.ink.usage: Dark labels and icons on primary or hover accent fills

accent.secondary.usage: Secondary accent, also used for type names in the source syntax arrangement

selection.background.usage: Translucent accent selection, serialized to an 8-bit alpha of 80/255; composite over the current surface

status.success.usage: Status foreground, icon or outline; pair with text or symbol to convey meaning

status.successBackground.usage: Tinted status-container fill; use matching status foreground

status.warning.usage: Status foreground, icon or outline; pair with text or symbol to convey meaning

status.warningBackground.usage: Tinted status-container fill; use matching status foreground

status.danger.usage: Status foreground, icon or outline; pair with text or symbol to convey meaning

status.dangerBackground.usage: Tinted status-container fill; use matching status foreground

status.info.usage: Status foreground, icon or outline; pair with text or symbol to convey meaning

status.infoBackground.usage: Tinted status-container fill; use matching status foreground

support.orange.usage: Optional data-series or category accent; use selectively, with labels/shapes for distinctions

support.chartreuse.usage: Optional data-series or category accent; use selectively, with labels/shapes for distinctions

notes: Muted text stays on canvas/panel; on raised use text.secondary or brighter.
On hover surfaces, use text.primary or text.emphasis.
Reference/syntax comment grade5 preserves upstream assignment but does not reach 4.5:1; use fg7 if legibility is the priority.
Semantic instructions are recommendations; shade changes require rechecking actual pairings.

source.method: Independent calculation from inspected source parameters and D65 CIELAB conversion; repository code was not executed
